# SPIKE-NNN: Spike Title

> Replace every placeholder. The experiment produces evidence, not production
> architecture. Code is disposable unless separately adopted through the
> normal lifecycle and engineering review.

## Target Questions

- Specific question this Spike must answer.

## Bounds / Stop Conditions

- Time, scope, platform, workload, or resource boundary.
- Condition for stopping even if the result is inconclusive.

## Method

Describe the prototype, benchmark, comparison, or experiment.

## Reproduction

List environment, inputs, commands, fixtures, and measurement method needed to
reproduce the result. Link disposable code under `experiments/` if present.

## Results

Record measurements and observations, including negative or inconclusive
results.

## Limitations

- Threat to validity, missing platform, or untested condition.

## Disposition

State which questions were answered and where the evidence feeds next. Do not
recommend copying Spike code into production by implication.

## References

- Parent Future Work, Exploration, or RFC and any evidence artifacts.
